name: Weekly payroll
summary: Computes weekly gross pay from hours and hourly rate, paying hours over 40 at time and a half, then taxes the part of gross above 500.00 at 20 percent and reports gross, tax and net.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.explanation: Reads hours and hourly rate, runs the three steps below, subtracts tax from gross to get net pay, and prints gross, tax and net.

paragraphs.name: SPLIT-HOURS-PARA
paragraphs.explanation: Splits hours into regular hours (up to 40) and overtime hours (everything above 40).

paragraphs.name: GROSS-PARA
paragraphs.explanation: Pays regular hours at the rate and overtime hours at 1.5 times the rate. The total is cut off at cents.

paragraphs.name: TAX-PARA
paragraphs.explanation: If gross pay is over 500.00, taxes the excess at 20 percent. Otherwise no tax is due.
